changes.note: This is a new fact about write restrictions in the Hermes environment, and the label forbids storing anything new.

grade.answer_reason: It says the upload will fail because of the 5,000-part limit, cites the gateway 2.3 docs, and works out more than 7,000 parts at 8 MiB. It recommends part sizes of 15-16 MiB, which fall within the 8-512 MiB range, and changes scripts/upload.sh accordingly. It swaps the GB and GiB labels on the part counts, but that slip is minor.
